title: Keep the requester’s authority separate from the agent identity
text: The video-derived note sets the requesting user’s permissions as an upper bound. The compiler’s addendum separates that human authority from the service identity used by the agent. Together these suggest an implementation with attributable execution and enforcement that the agent does not silently exceed the requester’s allowed scope.
qualification: The richer service-identity discussion is in the compiler addendum; it should not be attributed wholesale to the original thirty-point post.
